目的与结果状语从句:so that / such...that: so that + 目的(常含 can/could/may);so + adj./adv. + that 与 such + 名词 + that 表结果。

目的:so that + can/could/may/might|目的:in order that(更正式)|结果:so + adj./adv. + that|结果:such + (a/an) + adj. + 名词 + that|so many/much/few/little + 名词 + that(用 so 不用 such)|in order to / so as to + 动词原形(目的,主语相同)
He spoke slowly so that we could follow him.
column3: 他说得很慢,好让我们能跟上。

目的与结果状语从句:so that / such...that: The box is so heavy that I can't lift it.
It was such a boring film that we left early.
column3: 电影太无聊,我们提前走了。

# title: She left early ___ she could catch the first train.
column4: 目的从句用 so that + could。

# title: The story was ___ interesting that I read it twice.
column4: so + adj. + that 结果状语。

# title: It was ___ hot day that we went swimming twice.
column4: such + a + adj. + 单数名词。

# title: He saved money ___ buy a new laptop.

column4: in order to + 动词原形表目的。
